title: Pinning down a minstrel show
summary: Collette asks about a minstrel show and a San Francisco band; the Howards cannot date it.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I was tryin' to think of the name of that last band I played with up there, San Francisco.
Yeah, it's hard to--But at the time that San Francisco was--was that--I can't even think of when the earthquake and the fire was--would that be before it?
Oh, no.
The fire was in 1906.
1906 (chuckle). Okay, sorry about that.
Sorry about that.
(inaudible) I remember that, 1906.
So, at that time now, can I ask something else about the minstrel show?
Yeah.
ERASABLE COTTON CONTENT
Now, in (unintelligible) a minstrel show, they were all black performers on the stage, or were they white performers with black face?
White and black.
White performers, on with black face?
No, not with black face.
White and black.
Oh. But what about the audience? Mixed audience, (inaudible)?
Well, the audience was both white and black.
White and black. So this could've been what, 1930. Does that sound right?
'30? That's too far back.
Ms. Willard: He said it was earlier the Quality Serenaders. Mr. Collette: Earlier? Like the '20s?
Yeah, in the '20s.
Does that sound right, Ms. Howard? around the '20s?
I don't 'member that episode--that minstrel show, but I think he's got himself mixed up with (unintelligible).
Huh?
I said I think you're goin' back to Lionell's show, when you's traveling with them, because (unintelligible) you didn't go with no minstrel show before the Quality--
Oh, no. We didn't have a minstrel show.
I think it was with Lionel's bunch. I think it was (inaudible) you know, I didn't see the show myself, (inaudible) cause I just worked around here.
I went there, and I don't remember anything about it.
